title: ARV idea comes from Lazar, Sorensen and McKinnish

tellings.quote: a lot of that fell into the psyche of of the UFO Community because of Bob Lazar and then Brad Sensen and Mark Mark mcis

plain: Eric Davis, a physicist who has worked on government studies of unexplained craft, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that the idea of the ARV, short for alien reproduction vehicle, meaning a human-built craft said to copy alien technology, entered the thinking of UFO enthusiasts through a few men. He names Bob Lazar, Brad Sorensen and Mark McCandlish, each known for claims about secret craft. He means that the idea spread through their stories, which shapes how much weight it deserves.
